title: A magnetic eigenvalue bound in the disk
summary: We consider the magnetic Schrödinger operator in the unit disk with constant magnetic field of strength $b>0$ and magnetic Neumann boundary condition. If $λ_1(b)$ denotes its lowest eigenvalue, then we prove that $λ_1(b) 0$, where $Θ_0$ is the de Gennes constant. The proof has two parts, both based on Rayleigh's principle. For large $b$, we use a trial state built from the de Gennes ground state.
